name: GhostSwitch
description: Themed wrapper around headless GhostSwitch. Same behavioral props plus size and tone. Importing it loads the default stylesheet and scopes styles to this instance. Hand-written until GHO-13 generates manifests.

props.name: modelValue
props.description: Controlled on/off, forwarded to the unstyled GhostSwitch.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial on/off when modelValue is omitted, forwarded to the unstyled GhostSwitch.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Forwards native disabled semantics to the unstyled GhostSwitch.

props.name: readonly
props.description: Forwards read-only semantics to the unstyled GhostSwitch.

props.name: name
props.description: Form field name, forwarded to the unstyled GhostSwitch.

props.name: value
props.description: Submitted string when on, forwarded to the unstyled GhostSwitch.

props.name: form
props.description: External form id, forwarded to the unstyled GhostSwitch.

props.name: size
props.description: Control size. The default omits data-size so CSS can treat a missing hook as md.

props.name: tone
props.description: Semantic color of the on track. The default omits data-tone.

slots.name: default
slots.description: Optional inner content, usually a visible name. Prefer a label for=id or aria-label when the name should not sit inside the control.

exposed.name: element
exposed.description: The native switch button after mount; null before mount and after unmount. Delegates to the unstyled GhostSwitch.

exposed.name: checked
exposed.description: Current on/off. Delegates to the unstyled GhostSwitch.

exposed.name: toggle
exposed.description: User-activation toggle. Delegates to the unstyled GhostSwitch.

exposed.name: focus
exposed.description: Focuses the native button when it is mounted and enabled. Delegates to the unstyled GhostSwitch.

exposed.name: blur
exposed.description: Removes focus from the native button when it is mounted. Delegates to the unstyled GhostSwitch.

parts.name: root
parts.description: The native button element inside the display:contents themed scope.

parts.name: thumb
parts.description: Decorative thumb inside the track. aria-hidden.

states.name: checked
states.description: On appearance. Accent, neutral, or danger fill.

cssProperties.name: --ghost-surface-bg
cssProperties.description: Thumb color while off, and canvas behind the control.

cssProperties.name: --ghost-surface-muted-bg
cssProperties.description: Off-track fill.

cssProperties.name: --ghost-surface-fg
cssProperties.description: Hover and press overlay color on the track.

cssProperties.name: --ghost-motion-easing-standard
cssProperties.description: Easing of track color and thumb travel.

cssProperties.name: --ghost-border-hairline-width
cssProperties.description: Forced-colors track outline thickness.

cssProperties.name: --ghost-action-primary-bg
cssProperties.description: On-track fill for the accent tone.

cssProperties.name: --ghost-action-primary-fg
cssProperties.description: Thumb color on the accent on-track.

cssProperties.name: --ghost-action-neutral-bg
cssProperties.description: On-track fill for the neutral tone.

cssProperties.name: --ghost-action-neutral-fg
cssProperties.description: Thumb color on the neutral on-track.

cssProperties.name: --ghost-action-danger-bg
cssProperties.description: On-track fill for the danger tone.

cssProperties.name: --ghost-action-danger-fg
cssProperties.description: Thumb color on the danger on-track.

cssProperties.name: --ghost-action-disabled-bg
cssProperties.description: Disabled track fill.

cssProperties.name: --ghost-action-disabled-fg
cssProperties.description: Disabled thumb color.

cssProperties.name: --ghost-gradient-action-primary
cssProperties.description: On-track gradient for the accent tone.

cssProperties.name: --ghost-gradient-action-neutral
cssProperties.description: On-track gradient for the neutral tone.

cssProperties.name: --ghost-gradient-action-danger
cssProperties.description: On-track gradient for the danger tone.

cssProperties.name: --ghost-state-layer-hover
cssProperties.description: Hover overlay opacity on the track.

cssProperties.name: --ghost-state-layer-press
cssProperties.description: Pressed overlay opacity on the track.

cssProperties.name: --ghost-focus-ring-color
cssProperties.description: Outer color of the two-color keyboard focus indicator.

cssProperties.name: --ghost-focus-ring-contrast
cssProperties.description: Inner color of the two-color keyboard focus indicator.

cssProperties.name: --ghost-focus-ring-offset
cssProperties.description: Gap between the track edge and the focus ring.

cssProperties.name: --ghost-focus-ring-width
cssProperties.description: Thickness of the focus outline.

cssProperties.name: --ghost-control-size-sm-min
cssProperties.description: Track block size for size sm.

cssProperties.name: --ghost-control-size-md-min
cssProperties.description: Track block size for size md.

cssProperties.name: --ghost-control-size-lg-min
cssProperties.description: Track block size for size lg.

cssProperties.name: --ghost-space-gap-xs
cssProperties.description: Inset between the track edge and the thumb.

cssProperties.name: --ghost-space-gap-sm
cssProperties.description: Gap between the track and optional slot content.

cssProperties.name: --ghost-action-duration
cssProperties.description: Duration of track color and thumb travel.

cssProperties.name: --ghost-action-shadow
cssProperties.description: Resting shadow on the thumb and the inner focus contrast ring.

keyboard.Space: Toggle the switch when it is enabled and not readonly.
keyboard.Enter: Toggle the switch when it is enabled and not readonly. Implemented because the host is a native button; APG lists Enter as optional.
